facts.text: Date: 14 December 2025 — National Energy Conservation Day
facts.head: News

facts.text: Presented by: President Droupadi Murmu, New Delhi — NECA 2025 and National Painting Competition on Energy Conservation
facts.head: News

facts.text: NECA instituted: 1991, by Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE)
facts.head: Background

facts.text: BEE: statutory body, established 1 March 2002 under Energy Conservation Act, 2001
facts.head: Background

facts.text: BEE initiatives: Standards & Labeling, DSM, PAT → replaced by Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS), 2023
facts.head: Background

facts.text: BEE star label: on ceiling fans, electric geysers, tubular fluorescent lamps
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Scheme: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana; Key facts: February 2024; 1 crore households; up to 300 units free/month; subsidy ₹30,000 (1 kW), ₹60,000 (2 kW), ₹78,000 (3 kW+)
facts.head: Schemes cited

facts.text: Scheme: National Green Hydrogen Mission; Key facts: January 2023; ₹19,744 crore; 5 MMT/year by 2030; ₹8 lakh crore investment; avert 50 MMT GHG; SIGHT incentives
facts.head: Schemes cited

facts.text: Scheme: Renewable Consumption Obligation; Key facts: Formerly RPO; under Energy Conservation (Amendment) Act, 2022; 29.91% (FY25) → 43.33% (FY30)
facts.head: Schemes cited

facts.text: Scheme: PLI; Key facts: 14 sectors; incentives for 4–6 years
facts.head: Schemes cited
